name: bugfix
description: Reproduce a bug with a failing test, fix it, and review the fix

steps.title: Reproduce it
steps.prompt:
Write a test that fails because of this bug, and change nothing else: {bug}

Run it and show that it fails for the reason described.

steps.title: Fix it
steps.prompt:
Fix this bug so the failing test from the step before passes, without weakening that test: {bug}

Run the whole test suite before you stop.

steps.title: Review the fix
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file, the fix for: {bug}

Check that it fixes the cause rather than the symptom and breaks nothing near it. List each real problem with its file and line; say plainly when there is none.
